crossRefs.note: Behold, seven years of great plenty throughout all the land of Egypt are coming.
As a dream when one wakes up, so, Lord, when you awake, you will despise their fantasies.
“But Abraham said, ‘Son, remember that you, in your lifetime, received your good things, and Lazarus, in the same way…

people.name: Egypt
people.line: Ancient nation; Israelites enslaved there; plagues and Exodus

translations.web: The seven years of plenty, that were in the land of Egypt, came to an end.
translations.bsb: When the seven years of abundance in the land of Egypt came to an end,
translations.kjv: And the seven years of plenteousness, that was in the land of Egypt, were ended.
translations.asv: And the seven years of plenty, that was in the land of Egypt, came to an end.
